subject: Evaluation kickoff: next steps & scheduling
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood evaluation plan & next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today. Great to learn more about AcmeCorp's priorities (reduce per-token inference costs, improve 95th pctl latency for user-facing chat, and establish a repeatable eval workflow). As discussed, the next best step is an evaluation kickoff where we can:

- Align on success criteria and acceptance tests
- Share the trial plan and prompt/eval set
- Confirm infra/credential/access requirements for a short pilot
- Schedule a technical deep dive with our serving/runtime engineer

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 2026-03-18, 10:00–11:00am PT
- Wed 2026-03-18, 3:00–4:00pm PT
- Thu 2026-03-19, 9:00–10:00am PT

Attached is a short draft of the trial plan we typically run (scope, milestones, sample prompt set). Can you confirm who from your side should join (technical lead / data scientist)? If you prefer, I can also send a calendar invite for the slot you pick.

Next steps: please confirm preferred time and list of attendees. I’ll follow up with a calendar invite, trial-plan doc, and an intake form to capture success criteria.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-eval-trial-plan.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood evaluation plan & next steps

Neha — adding a quick note from the runtime side. For the technical deep dive it would be helpful if Acme can confirm:

- Whether the workload will be mainly chat (multi-turn) or single-turn generation
- Typical sequence lengths and QPS targets (even rough numbers)
- Whether we’ll need private (VPC) deployment for the pilot or if hosted API is ok for the initial evaluation

Also, if Jordan can confirm availability for Wed 3/18 10am PT that works for me — I’ll be the one on the call to cover batching/quantization tradeoffs and connectivity.

—Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Geller <alex.geller@acmecorp.com>, Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood evaluation plan & next steps

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the recap and the plan. Wed 3/18 10:00am PT works for us; please send the invite. Attendees from Acme will be myself (product lead) and Alex Geller (data scientist). We may also loop in our infra lead (TBD) if needed.

A couple quick asks before the kickoff:
- Can you call out the two or three measurable success criteria you typically track for a pilot like this? (latency pctl, token cost, throughput)
- Any pre-reads we should review? I saw the attachment but would prefer a one-page summary of milestones and what you need from our side (credentials, sample prompts, baseline metrics).

Looking forward to the call.

—Jordan
Product Lead, AcmeCorp
[jordan.smith@acmecorp.com]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Redwood evaluation plan & next steps

Thanks Jordan — confirmed for Wed 3/18 10:00–11:00am PT. I’ve sent a calendar invite (see link below) and attached a one-page kickoff summary plus the trial plan.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Typical measurable success criteria we track for pilots:
  1) 95th-percentile latency <= target you define (example: <= 300ms for chat)
  2) Per-token inference cost reduction vs baseline (example: 30% lower)
  3) Quality: human-evaluated pass rate on your prompt set / automated eval thresholds (we’ll work with your team to define pass/fail for the initial prompt set)

Pre-reads: short kickoff summary (attached) + intake form — please fill the form with current baselines and expected targets so we can prep. Link to intake form is in the calendar invite and here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/redwood-eval-intake-form

Agenda for the kickoff (15/45):
- 15m: Goals, success criteria, milestones, roles
- 20m: Trial plan & access/infra checklist
- 15m: Technical deep dive (runtime/connectivity) and next steps

Attachments: redwood-eval-kickoff-onepager.pdf, redwood-eval-trial-plan.pdf

See you Wednesday — I’ll include Connor for the technical portion and Marissa will run the evaluation logistics (sample prompts, reporting cadence).

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-eval-kickoff-20260318
[Attachment: redwood-eval-kickoff-onepager.pdf (PDF, 8KB)]
